messages.subject: soap film smoother checking script
parts:
Hi listfolk,

[This may only be useful for minimal number of "advanced" dsm users, but
I thought I'd post it here just in case someone finds it useful.]

A wee while ago I wrote a simple script for checking the setup of soap
film smoothers, since I never seem to be able to get them right the
first time.

The script checks that the boundary is "correct", data and knots are
inside the boundary and gives some graphical output to help you
understand where you went wrong. In the simplest case it will plot the
boundary and highlight in red what you're modelling, if you give it
knots and data it will also check that all data and knots are inside the
boundary. Multiple boundaries (islands) are supported.

You can find the code and examples on github at
https://github.com/dill/soap_checker and you can download all the files
in one zip here https://github.com/dill/soap_checker/archive/master.zip

If you use this and find any bugs or have suggestions for improvements
then please do let me know (via e-mail or the "Issues" tab on github).



All the best,
--dave
